Au t 31, 1938. Morning Translation.

Ta Mei Pao and other local newspapers :-

ATTEMPT ON LIFE OF CHAIRMAN OF NANTAO AUTONOMOUS ASSOCIATION

At 9.30 a.m. yesterday, Chen Yuin(陳雲), a lawyer, Chairman of the Nantao Autonomous Association, was shot at by two gunmen in front of his residence, Lane 383, House No. 42, Medhurst Road, as he was about to enter his motor car. One bullet entered the hip and penetrated the abdomen. Chen was seriously wounded and collapsed. The chauffeur named Zee Kyih-tan (徐吉潭) was slightly wounded in the head.

Chinese policeman No. 1219, who was on post duty in the vicinity, rushed to the scene and fired two shots. The gunmen made good their escape. Chen Yuin was removed to the Paulun Hospital and is confined in Room No. 304. It is reported that his condition is very serious.

Chen Yuin alias Chen Tsoo-dong (陳祖桐) alias Chen Yuin-chi (陳云遲), age 35, joined the Chinese Bar Association in February, 1935. Formerly he resided in Nantao and was an assistant in the office of a Japanese lawyer named Murakami. On the recommendation of Murakami, Chen Yuin became Chairman of the Nantao Autonomous Association in January this year. On July 7, the Association was reorganized into the Nantao District Office of the Shanghai Municipal Administration under the control of the Administration, of which Chen became Chief. On August 1, the Office became known as the Nantao Political Affairs Office with Chen as Chief. The Nantao Political Affairs Office has three sections, namely, a General Affairs Section, a Finance Section and a Social Section. Chen is very skillful in collecting money from the people with the result that people in Nantao are very dissatisfied with him.

Hwa Mei Chen Poo :-

After Chen Yuin became Chairman of the Nantao Autonomous Association, he removed to Sin Tsung (星都), Sinza Road. He rented several rooms for a long period in the Yangtsze Hotel (揚子飯店), Yunnan Road, to make secret negotiations. Sometimes, he passed the night in this hotel. His parents, wife and two children live together with him. Chen returns home once every three or four days. This time however, he had not visited his house for a week. Chen's wife Chen Yih Sz (陳葉氏) was formerly a female employee of the Young Studio (華明), Nanking Road. Chen has three bodyguards who used to follow him all the time, but none accompanied him yesterday morning when the shooting affray took place. His children, one boy and a girl, are studying in the Sun Kiang Primary School (申江小學).

Chen's original name was Chen Ju (陳虎), but he began to use the name of Chen Yuin when he became Chairman of the Nantao Autonomous Association. The Vice-Chairman of the Association is Ling Chi-tan (凌智潭).

1938年8月31日。晨间译件。

《大美报》及其他本地报纸：

南市自治协会主席遇刺案

昨日上午9时30分，律师、南市自治协会主席陈云（Chen Yuin）在麦赫斯特路（Medhurst Road）383弄42号寓所门前，正欲进入其汽车时，遭两名枪手射击。一颗子弹击中臀部并穿透腹部。陈受重伤倒地。名为徐吉潭（Zee Kyih-tan）的司机头部受轻伤。

当时在附近执勤的华捕1219号迅速赶至现场并开枪两发。枪手成功逃脱。陈云被送往宝隆医院（Paulun Hospital），现留院于304病房。据报其病情危重。

陈云，又名陈祖桐（Chen Tsoo-dong），又名陈云迟（Chen Yuin-chi），现年35岁，于1935年2月加入中国律师公会。此前他居住于南市，曾在一名名为村上（Murakami）的日本律师办事处担任助理。经村上推荐，陈云于今年1月出任南市自治协会主席。7月7日，该协会改组为受市政府控制的上海特别市行政机构下属的南市区公署，陈云任主任。8月1日，该公署更名为南市政务局，陈云任局长。南市政务局下设三个科，即总务科、财务科和社会科。陈云在向民众敛财方面手段高明，导致南市民众对其极为不满。

《华美晨报》：

陈云出任南市自治协会主席后，搬至星都（Sin Tsung），新闸路（Sinza Road）。他在云南路的扬子饭店（Yangtsze Hotel）长期包租数个房间，用于秘密谈判。有时，他在此酒店过夜。其父母、妻子及两名子女与他同住。陈每三至四天回家一次。然而此次，他已有一周未归家。陈妻陈叶氏（Chen Yih Sz）原为南京路华明影片公司（Young Studio）的女职员。陈有三名保镖，以往时刻跟随，但昨日早晨发生枪击事件时，无一人在旁陪同。其子女，一男一女，就读于申江小学（Sun Kiang Primary School）。

陈原名陈虎（Chen Ju），但在出任南市自治协会主席后开始使用陈云之名。该协会副主席为凌智潭（Ling Chi-tan）。

On arrival at the scene, police from
Gordon Road station were in attendance, and a party

The following was ascertained:-

At about 3.05 p.m. 10/9/36, Mr. Chen Kung,
Chairman of the Shanghai-Nantao Administration,
member of the Nantao District Guild; by profession
a lawyer and assistant to Dr. Okamoto, lawyer, 103
Kinkiang Road, and ex S.M.P. clerk, residing at
1038/42 Sinza Road, left his home in his private
motor car, licence No. 5350, driven by his
chauffeur Lee Chih Zen (李智珍), permit No.14918,
26 years, Ningpo, 632/8 Connaught Road.

As the motor car was coming out of Lane 1038,
and turning west into Sinza Road, two male Chinese
who were standing at the mouth of the lane, suddenly
pulled out pistols, and opened fire on the motor car.
They fired at point blank range. They fired at the
chauffeur from the front of the car. The chauffeur
ducked, and was only slightly grazed by a bullet
which passed over the top of his head. Mr. Chen Kung
who occupied the rear seat of the car was then fired
at, and one bullet hit him in the back, and came out
of his stomach. Mr. Chen Kung attempted to use his
own pistol which he carried, but failed to bring it

into action.

In all, about 15 shots were fired, as is shown by
the bullet holes scattered over the body work of the car.
The chauffeur pulled the car to a stop just outside
the entrance to the lane.

C.P.C. 1219 (No. 30 - S.M.) was on duty at the
Tsing Lung Tze Temple on the opposite side of the
roadway, and about 50 yards east of the scene. He
heard shots fired from the direction of Lane 1039, and
looking in that direction, saw a male Chinese point a
pistol and fire at Mr. Chen Yuen's motor car.

C.P.C. 1219 at once drew his pistol, and opened
fire at the armed man as he made his escape west along
Sinsa Road. He fired two shots at the man, but it is
believed they did not take effect.

The written statement of C.P.C. 1219 is attached
herewith.

Two witnesses of the shooting were located:-

Tsu You Zai (朱有仔) private watchman on duty
at the lane states that he gave Mr. Chen Yuen's car the
right-away signal out of the lane, and at the same time
saw two men who were standing at the mouth of the lane,
pull out pistols, and fire upon the car. They then
escaped by running west along Sinsa Road.

司机将车停在弄堂入口外不远处。

华捕1219号（编号30 - SM）当时在对面的
青龙寺（Tsing Lung Tze Temple）执勤，地点位于案发地以东约50码处。
他听到来自1039弄方向的枪声，朝该方向望去，
看见一名中国男子用手枪指向陈元（Chen Yuen）先生的汽车并开火。

华捕1219号立即拔出手枪，
向沿新闸路向西逃跑的持枪男子开火。
他向该男子发射了两发子弹，但据信并未击中。

华捕1219号的书面陈述附后。

找到了两名枪击案目击者：

朱有仔（Tsu You Zai），在弄堂执勤的私人更夫，
称他向陈元先生的汽车发出放行信号让其驶出弄堂，
同时看见两名站在弄口的男子
拔出手枪，向汽车开火。随后他们
沿新闸路向西奔跑逃逸。

pages.en:
L'...,'38.
1/sheet 4.

His written statement is attached.
Asu Sai ( ), a hawker who has a stall at the
mouth of the lane, corroborates the statements made by the
watchman. His written statement is also attached.
13 bullet cases of the .32 and 9 m.m. type were
found on the roadway. 7 spent bullets were taken out
of the car furnishings. These have been forwarded to
Headquarters for examination.
Mr. Chen Yuan and his chauffeur were at once sent
by ambulance to the Paklum Hospital. Mr. Chen Yuan was
detained, suffering from "bullet wound of abdomen -
condition serious". The chauffeur, after treatment,
was allowed to leave the hospital, and was brought to this
station for questioning.
Mr. Chen Yuan's pistol was handed to D.I. Todd by
Insp. White. This pistol, No. Y 1471 is now kept at
this station pending disposal.
Mr. Chen Yuan's motor car is also at present kept
at this station.
A search of all shops, houses and lanes was carried
out as far west as Gordon Road, but without result.
D.C. "B", D.D.O, "F" and G.S were informed. D.D.O.
"F" and D.D.I. Crighton and party attended.
Whilst Mr. Chen Yuan is detained at the British
Hospital, Sham Shui Po will supply a guard.

阿四（Asu Sai）（ ），一名在弄口摆摊的小贩，
证实了更夫的陈述。其书面陈述亦附后。
在路面上发现了13枚.32口径和9毫米口径的弹壳。
从车内装饰中取出了7枚射出的子弹。
这些已送交总局检验。
陈元先生及其司机立即由救护车送往宝隆医院（Paklum Hospital）。
陈元先生被留院治疗，诊断为“腹部枪伤 - 病情危重”。
司机经治疗后获准离开医院，并被带至本巡捕房接受讯问。
陈元先生的手枪由怀特督察（Insp. White）移交给托德探长（D.I. Todd）。
该手枪，编号Y 1471，现存放于本巡捕房，待处理。
陈元先生的汽车目前也存放于本巡捕房。
对向西直至戈登路的所有商店、房屋和弄堂进行了搜查，但无结果。
已通知“B”区副总监、“F”区副总监及总务处。“F”区副总监
及克莱顿副督察（D.D.I. Crighton）及其随行人员到场。
鉴于陈元先生被羁押于英商医院（British Hospital），深水埗（Sham Shui Po）将提供警卫。

pages.en:
Statement of Woo Loon Tsing (
J..C. 1219 attached to Jordan Road Station.

Statement

At 9.05 a.m. 30/8/38, whilst I was on duty at the
main gate of the Tsing Lung Sz Temple Refugee Camp, Jinse
Road, I heard several pistol shots firing from opposite
direction. On looking to the direction where the firing
came from, I saw a male Chinese assassin point his pistol
and fire at a green coloured sedan motor car which was
parked outside the Sin Villa alleyway. I immediately drew
out my service pistol and fired two shots at the assassin who
then absconded by running west along Jinse Road. The assassin
was wearing grey serge jacket and of slim build. Later I
telephoned the Police Station for ambulance which came
immediate after and conveyed two wounded persons to Paulun
Hospital. The scene of the assassination is about 50 yards
away from my place where I stood. The above is my true
statement.

30/8/38.
J.P.C. 1219 Woo Loon Tsing.
pages.zh:
吴龙清（Woo Loon Tsing）（
隶属戈登路巡捕房的华捕1219号）的陈述。

陈述

1938年8月30日上午9时05分，当我在金世路（Jinse Road）青龙寺难民营（Tsing Lung Sz Temple Refugee Camp）大门执勤时，
我听到对面方向传来数声手枪射击声。朝枪声来源方向望去，
我看见一名中国刺客用手枪指向一辆停在辛别墅（Sin Villa）弄堂外的绿色轿车并开火。
我立即拔出配枪，向刺客发射两发子弹，
该刺客随即沿金世路向西奔跑逃逸。
刺客身穿灰色哔叽夹克，身材瘦削。
随后我打电话给巡捕房呼叫救护车，救护车随即赶到，
将两名伤者送往宝隆医院。
刺杀现场距离我站立的位置约50码。
以上是我的真实陈述。

1938年8月30日.
华捕1219号 吴龙清.

pages.en:
Statement of □□ □□, □□ 41, native of Kiangsu,
dyer, residing at 17 □□ Road.

stated:

I was standing at the mouth of No. 109 Nanking
Road. At about □□ 10/3/38, two male Chinese, both
wearing short jacket, suddenly pointed their pistols and
fired 8 or 9 shots at a private motor car, S.M.C. Licence
No. 5350, which was driving out of the lane. Immediately
after the shooting, the two men concealed their pistols in
pocket and escaped by running west along Nanking Road. Later
police came and chased after them. I saw one male Chinese
lying in the motor car. He was removed away by ambulance.
The descriptions of the two assassins are as follows:
(1) Age about 30, height about 5'6", medium build, dark round
face, hair cropped short, wearing blue cloth jacket and pants,
Armed with black pistol.
(2) Age about 26, height about 5'4", medium build, sallow
round face, wearing white jacket and pants. Armed with black
pistol.

10/3/38.
(signed) Hsu Sai.
pages.zh:
□□ □□的陈述，□□ 41岁，江苏籍，
染匠，居住于□□路17号。

陈述：

我当时站在南京路109号弄口。
约□□ 1938年3月10日，两名中国男子，均
身穿短夹克，突然拔出手枪，
向一辆驶出弄堂的私人汽车（工部局牌照
号5350）发射了8或9发子弹。枪击发生后，
两人将手枪藏入口袋，沿南京路向西奔跑逃逸。
随后警察赶到并追捕他们。我看见一名中国男子
躺在汽车内。他被救护车运走。
两名刺客的描述如下：
(1) 年龄约30岁，身高约5英尺6英寸，中等身材，黑圆脸，
短发，身穿蓝色布夹克和长裤，
持有黑色手枪。
(2) 年龄约26岁，身高约5英尺4英寸，中等身材，黄
圆脸，身穿白色夹克和长裤。持有黑色
手枪。

1938年3月10日.
（签名）许赛（Hsu Sai）.

pages.en:
Statement of Tsu You Ai (      ), age 39, native of
Yangchow, Kiangsu/watchman employed in Lane 1039 since 1924.

At about 9.30 a.m. 30/8/38, whilst I was on duty in the
lane, I saw a tenant of House 42, named "Tang" riding in a
private motor car, Licence No. 5380, drive out from the lane.
I then stood at the entrance of the lane to regulate traffic
and allow the motor car to pass. When the car arrived at
the end of the lane, two male Chinese, one wearing white
cloth jacket while the other wearing blue cloth jacket, suddenly
produced their pistols and fired 8 or 9 shots at the occupants of
the car, after which they concealed their pistols in pocket and
decamped by running west along Sian Road. Immediately after
police came and chased after the absconding men. I saw the tenant
"Tang" lying in the car. Later ambulance came and conveyed him
to hospital. The driver of the motor car was also taken to
hospital. The descriptions of the two assassins are as follows:
(1) age about 30, height about 5'5", medium build, dark round
face, hair cropped short, wearing blue cloth jacket and
pants. Armed with a black pistol.
(2) A male Chinese wearing white cloth jacket and pants.
Armed with a black pistol, other description not available.

30/8/38.
(signed) Tsu You Ai.
pages.zh:
朱有爱（Tsu You Ai）（      ）的陈述，39岁，江苏扬州籍/自1924年起受雇于1039弄的更夫。

1938年8月30日上午9时30分左右，当我在弄堂内执勤时，
我看见42号住户，姓“唐”者，乘坐一辆牌照号为5380的私人汽车驶出弄堂。
于是我站在弄堂入口处指挥交通，让汽车通过。
当汽车到达弄堂尽头时，两名中国男子，一人身穿白色
布夹克，另一人身穿蓝色布夹克，突然
拔出手枪，向车内人员发射了8或9发子弹，
随后他们将手枪藏入口袋，沿西安路（Sian Road）向西逃窜。
警察随即赶到并追捕逃逸者。我看见住户
“唐”躺在车内。随后救护车赶到并将其送往医院。
汽车司机也被送往医院。
两名刺客的描述如下：
(1) 年龄约30岁，身高约5英尺5英寸，中等身材，黑圆脸，
短发，身穿蓝色布夹克和
长裤。持有黑色手枪。
(2) 一名中国男子，身穿白色布夹克和长裤。
持有黑色手枪，其他描述不详。

1938年8月30日.
（签名）朱有爱.
